instruction.title: Show Phonetics
instruction.text: In the text, VIEW shows you the phonetic representation of each Russian word.

instruction.title: Hover
instruction.text: VIEW will show you the correct phonetic transcription for the Russian word marked in green when you hover over it.

instruction.title: Multiple Choice
instruction.text: Choose a Russian phonetic sequence from the drop-down list and VIEW will show you whether you guessed right or wrong. You can get help by clicking on ?.

instruction.title: Fill in the blanks
instruction.text: Fill in the blanks with the correct Russian phonetic sequence. If you guessed wrong or you find it too difficult you can get help by clicking on ?.
